nodes.description: Public state variable holding the UniswapV2 factory interface, fixed to an externally deployed contract address
Public view function that returns an array of Uniswap pair addresses by looping over univ2Factory.allPairs
uint256 parameter giving the starting index for the allPairs lookup
uint256 parameter giving the number of pairs to fetch and the length of the returned array
address[] memory output array allocated with length cnt and filled inside the loop
uint256 loop counter bounded by cnt
External low-level call to univ2Factory.allPairs(i+start) on a state-variable-controlled contract address
Unchecked unsigned addition i + start compiled with Solidity ^0.6.0, allowing silent integer overflow

edges.reason: State variable univ2Factory supplies the target contract for the external allPairs call
Parameter start flows into the unchecked addition i + start
Loop counter i flows into the unchecked addition i + start
Overflowed index result of i + start is consumed as the allPairs argument
Function body evaluates the i + start addition on every loop iteration
Function body executes the external allPairs call inside the loop
Parameter cnt determines the allocated length of the out array
Return value of the allPairs external call is written into out[i]
The function's for loop initializes and increments the counter i

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter start is only consumed by the unchecked addition, so it should be folded into the arithmetic unsafe operation node
Loop counter i is only consumed by the unchecked addition i + start and should be folded into that unsafe operation node
Parameter cnt only sizes the output array and bounds the loop, so it merges into the enclosing core function
Local array out is a transient buffer returned by the function and merges into getPairs
